proposal.summary: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XXE attacks that lead to information disclosure. A fixed firmware version is LW80.*.P246 (P246 or higher required).
proposal.affected_product: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25
proposal.cwe_quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

C.quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Reproduce the XXE on an affected device/firmware to confirm impact, capture the data disclosed, and coordinate mitigation. Recommend deploying firmware LW80.*.P246 (P246 or later) to affected devices.

evidence_quotes.quote: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25
allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

The fixed firmware version is LW80.*.P246, i.e., '*' indicates that the full version specification varies across product model family, but firmware level P246 (or higher) is required to remediate the vulnerability.
